results.name: exam-1-kaoyan-math
results.llm_reason: Strong exam focus with time pressure and test-specific analysis

plan.objective: 识别近五年考研数学真题的高频考点与时间陷阱。
plan.prerequisite_check: 能否在无提示下列出多元函数极值的求解步骤？
plan.hook_concrete: 2022年考研数学一真题第17题，满分12分，平均得分仅3.5分。基础扎实的你为何拿不到一半的分？
path: 限时15分钟独立解答一道近三年高频真题大题并记录用时
对照官方评分标准批改自己的卷面，标出步骤分扣分点
提炼该题的考点套路与时间陷阱，写出三条实战避坑原则
基于避坑原则，用5分钟重写该题关键得分步骤

micro_proof.stimulus: 粘贴你提炼的三条实战避坑原则与重写的关键得分步骤。
micro_proof.expected_signal: 文本包含三条原则及重写步骤，重写步骤含≥2个评分标准关键词如'偏导数为零'或'判别式'
micro_proof.fail_mode: 仅抄写原题解法或原则为空泛口号如'仔细计算'

plan.next_lesson_seed: 应用避坑原则限时拆解线代高频真题。

results.name: growth-3-whisper
results.llm_reason: Strongly aligned: hands-on dimension tracing, LoRA implementation, and transfer to accent fine-tuning, all beyond exam scope.

plan.objective: 在 Whisper 代码中插入自定义 LoRA 层并跑通前向传播
plan.prerequisite_check: 你能用 PyTorch 写一个单层 Linear 的 forward 吗？
plan.hook_concrete: Whisper 的输入不是音频波形，而是 80 维 mel 谱图矩阵。直接 fork 代码加 nn.Linear 会因维度不匹配而报错。
path: 用 torchaudio 将一段 wav 转成 80 维 mel 谱图并打印 shape
加载 WhisperModel 并追踪从 mel 谱图到 encoder 最后输出的 tensor 维度变化
编写一个 LoRA nn.Module，接收 Whisper 的 hidden_size 并输出同维度
将 LoRA 层挂载到 Whisper encoder 的某个 Linear 层并跑通一个 forward pass

micro_proof.stimulus: 贴出你加 LoRA 后跑通 forward pass 的代码和输出 tensor 的 shape
micro_proof.expected_signal: 输出包含一个 shape 为 [1, seq_len, hidden_size] 的 tensor，且代码里有自定义 LoRA 类
micro_proof.fail_mode: 输出报错或 tensor shape 不含 hidden_size 维度

plan.next_lesson_seed: 用你的 LoRA 层微调 Whisper 适配特定口音数据

results.name: growth-4-system-design
results.llm_reason: Focuses on transfer and deep understanding of system design patterns

plan.objective: Contrast feed fan-out on write versus on read for a Twitter-like system.
plan.prerequisite_check: Can you explain why a single PostgreSQL table struggles with millions of concurrent writes?
plan.hook_concrete: A celebrity with 50M followers posts a tweet. Writing 50M rows to a single DB table before returning 'OK' takes minutes. How does Twitter return 'OK' in milliseconds?
path: Map out the single-DB write bottleneck for a celebrity tweet using fan-out on write.
Sketch the fan-out on read approach using a reverse-chronological query per user.
Draw a hybrid model routing celebrities to fan-out on read and regular users to fan-out on write.
Annotate the hybrid sketch with the cache and async queue required for each path.

micro_proof.stimulus: Paste your hybrid fan-out sketch showing both celebrity and regular user paths.
micro_proof.expected_signal: sketch contains two distinct paths, an async queue on the write path, and a cache/DB lookup on the read path
micro_proof.fail_mode: Only one fan-out path shown, or missing async queue for writes.

plan.next_lesson_seed: Design a consistent hashing ring to distribute those 50M writes across multiple shards.

results.name: hybrid-1-saa-iam
results.llm_reason: Growth signals strong (transfer, depth, CLI verification); no exam signals (deadline, test scope) present.

plan.objective: Construct an IAM policy granting scoped S3 read access for your SaaS tenant.
plan.prerequisite_check: Can you manually create an S3 bucket in the AWS console?
plan.hook_concrete: A wildcard S3 policy `s3:*` on `*` lets any compromised role delete every tenant's data. Write the exact policy line that restricts access to only one tenant prefix.
path: Write a JSON policy allowing s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::my-saas-bucket/tenant-123/*.
Add a second statement allowing s3:ListBucket on the bucket with a StringEquals condition key for tenant-123.
Attach the policy to a new IAM User and run an AWS CLI s3 cp command to verify read access.
Attempt an s3 rm command on the same object to confirm the write action is denied.

micro_proof.stimulus: Paste the IAM policy JSON that limits a user to list and read only their own tenant prefix.
micro_proof.expected_signal: JSON contains Statement array with Effect Allow, Action includes s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket, Resource contains tenant-specific ARN, and Condition key restricts s3:prefix.
micro_proof.fail_mode: Policy uses Effect Allow with Action s3:* and Resource * without Condition.

plan.next_lesson_seed: Use STS AssumeRole to generate temporary scoped credentials for tenants.
